'''Edwin Dunn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[May 2001 Findlay tournament]] on 12 May 2001 with EBO X-wings, according to Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2285">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-12-findlay-ohio-5-12-01d2285/ findlay-ohio-5-12-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 12 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-12-findlay-ohio-5-12-01d2285/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
